mobbin:a6f030e2-5e59-4c27-80a3-a16e8cd88.summary: User views Sequences Analytics, opens Export → Share to web, sets password + filter-interact toggle, then gets a copyable share URL.
steps: Sequences Analytics — KPI cards, funnel, weekly line + Export
Export menu — Share to web / Download / Send to email
Share your data — password field + Allow viewers to interact with filters ON
Password set — locked Set control; filter toggle still on
Share link ready — explo.co/share URL + Copy + filter toggle
steal: Single Export menu branching Share to web / Download / Send to email (step 1).
“Allow viewers to interact with filters” toggle on shared dashboards (steps 2–4).
Copyable live share URL after setup (step 4).
avoid: Share host is third-party explo.co (step 4) — prefer first-party dean digest links under Essentials domain.
mobbin:a6f030e2-5e59-4c27-80a3-a16e8cd88.fit: Closest pattern to Baseline auto digests-by-link: shareable report URL with optional password and controlled interactivity.

mobbin:8f313eb2-7e52-42e2-9b78-1f6f33252.summary: User opens Export → Send to email, picks PDF or IMAGE, enters recipient, and gets “Email will be sent shortly” confirmation.
steps: Analytics + Export menu — Share to web / Download / Send to email
Send to email — PDF selected, IMAGE option, empty email, Send disabled
Email entered — Send email enabled (PDF still selected)
Confirmation — “Email will be sent shortly” under Send email
steal: Format choice PDF vs IMAGE before send (steps 1–3).
Send stays disabled until email present (step 1).
Inline success: “Email will be sent shortly” without leaving the dashboard (step 3).
mobbin:8f313eb2-7e52-42e2-9b78-1f6f33252.fit: Push delivery for stakeholders who won’t open a link; complements scheduled weekly/monthly digests without a report builder.
